Lee · Listen & Shadow 19

The Friday Report — reporting back, rebuilding trust
D O   E N G L I S H   W I T H   B R I A N
SCENE 1 · THE WEEK
👤 Friend
How are your Mondays usually?
월요일은 보통 어때?
usually — 보통
💬 Lee
Mondays are only busy with the weekly meeting and clearing pending items.
월요일은 주간회의랑 밀린 일 처리로만 바쁜 정도예요.
pending — 밀린, 처리 안 된 · clear — 처리하다
같은 패턴으로 — Fridays are only busy with reports. · My mornings are busy with emails and calls.
👤 Friend
Did your company do the media art at Inspire Hotel?
인스파이어 호텔 미디어아트, 거기 회사가 한 거야?
media art — 미디어아트
💬 Lee
It wasn't us, but they came to us before that.
우리가 한 건 아니고, 그 전에 우리한테 왔었어요.
come to ~ — ~에게 문의하러 오다
같은 패턴으로 — It wasn't me, but they asked me first. · It wasn't our team, but we bid on it.
💬 Lee
Most of my married friends go to Yeongjong-do for a vacation alone.
결혼한 친구들 대부분은 혼자 영종도로 휴가를 가요.
alone — 혼자
같은 패턴으로 — Most of my friends go to Jeju in winter. · Most of my team goes home early on Fridays.
💬 Lee
I met an advertising company last weekend to add a service to ours.
지난 주말엔 우리 서비스에 하나 더 붙이려고 광고회사를 만났어요.
advertising company — 광고회사 · add — 더하다
같은 패턴으로 — I met a supplier last week to lower the cost. · We met a designer to refresh the brand.
💬 Lee
We're trying to work it out at the moment.
지금 조율하는 중이에요.
work out — 잘 풀다, 조율하다 · at the moment — 지금
같은 패턴으로 — We're trying to work it out with the client. · They're trying to work out the schedule.
SCENE 2 · THE FIRST LINE
👤 Friend
At a bar, what's your first line?
바에서 처음 말을 걸면 뭐라고 해?
line — (말) 한마디
💬 Lee
Hi — I've been looking at you.
안녕하세요 — 아까부터 보고 있었어요.
have been ~ing — 계속 ~하고 있었다
같은 패턴으로 — Hi — I couldn't help looking over here. · Hi — I've been meaning to say hello.
💬 Lee
Can I offer you a drink?
한잔 사도 될까요?
offer — 권하다, 제안하다
같은 패턴으로 — Can I offer you a seat? · Can I offer you a hand with that?
💬 Lee
You look gorgeous tonight. Can I buy you a drink?
오늘 정말 멋지시네요. 한잔 사드려도 될까요?
gorgeous — 아주 멋진
같은 패턴으로 — You look great tonight. Can I buy you a coffee? · You look sharp — new jacket?
💬 Lee
Hey, you look amazing tonight. Can I get you a drink? Gin and tonic?
오늘 진짜 멋져요. 한잔 어때요? 진토닉?
amazing — 놀랍도록 멋진
같은 패턴으로 — Can I get you a drink? Wine? · Can I get you anything — water, maybe?
💬 Lee
The gin and tonic here is the best. Let me get you one.
여기 진토닉이 제일 맛있어요. 제가 한잔 사드릴게요.
the best — 최고인
같은 패턴으로 — The coffee here is the best. Let me get you one. · Their pasta is the best — let me order for us.
💬 Lee
I can keep you company, if you like.
괜찮으시면 옆에 있어드릴게요.
keep someone company — 곁에 있어주다 (accompany는 동사라 'be your accompany'는 틀린 표현)
같은 패턴으로 — I can keep you company until they arrive. · She kept me company all evening.
SCENE 3 · KEEPING IT GOING
👤 Friend
She answers — then what?
대답이 오면, 그다음은?
answer — 대답하다
💬 Lee
What made you come here — travel, vacation, or work?
여긴 어쩌다 오셨어요 — 여행이에요, 휴가예요, 일이에요?
what made you ~ — 어쩌다 ~하게 됐나요
같은 패턴으로 — What made you come to Seoul? · What made you pick this place?
💬 Lee
You can call me Lee.
저는 Lee라고 불러주세요.
call — 부르다
같은 패턴으로 — You can call me anytime. · You can call it whatever you like.
💬 Lee
I'm a painter and a media artist here in Korea.
저는 한국에서 화가이자 미디어 아티스트예요.
painter — 화가 · media artist — 미디어 아티스트
같은 패턴으로 — I'm a designer and a photographer. · He's a chef and a food writer.
💬 Lee
I paint on LED displays.
LED 디스플레이 위에 그림을 그려요.
display — 디스플레이, 화면
같은 패턴으로 — I work with light and screens. · She paints on glass.
💬 Lee
Same here — I also love gin and tonic.
저도요 — 저도 진토닉 좋아해요.
same here — 저도 그래요
같은 패턴으로 — Same here — I also hate mornings. · Same here — I also grew up abroad.
💬 Lee
If you like good Korean food, I can take you — or I can recommend a place.
한식 좋아하시면 제가 데려가 드릴 수도, 한 곳 추천해 드릴 수도 있어요.
recommend — 추천하다
같은 패턴으로 — If you like coffee, I can take you to my spot. · If you like jazz, I can recommend a bar.
💬 Lee
Is there anything I shouldn't miss here?
여기서 꼭 봐야 할 게 뭐예요?
miss — 놓치다
같은 패턴으로 — Is there anything I shouldn't miss in Seoul? · Anything I shouldn't miss on the menu?
💬 Lee
It was a great conversation. I should let you get back to your friends.
대화 정말 즐거웠어요. 친구분들께 돌아가셔야죠.
get back to ~ — ~로 돌아가다
같은 패턴으로 — I should let you get back to work. · I should let you get back to your dinner.
💬 Lee
Can I get your number?
연락처 좀 알려주실래요?
number — 전화번호
같은 패턴으로 — Can I get your email? · Can I get your name again?
느리게 24/24 · 보통 24/24
